kultivator.formasi.spec.five_layer_shiel: Heaven-grade layers over your Grand Sect Formation (radius up to 48). Layer 5 (always on): projectiles shot by hostile mobs vanish with a ripple when they cross the shell inward. Layer 6 (needs a Nascent Soul keeper or the complete Ten Thousand Immortals): intruders inside get Weakness I and creepers inside are held so they never explode. While it runs, the Grand Formation lodestone uses no amethyst. Needs the Grand Sect Formation active and the eye within 32 blocks of the stele.

True north only. Five element peaks, 4 body blocks and a lamp each: Water north (polished blackstone, sea lantern), Wood east (bamboo block, verdant froglight), Fire south-east (cinnabar or red nether bricks, shroomlight), Earth south-west (smooth sandstone, ochre froglight), Metal west (iron block, pearlescent froglight). A diamond block under the eye.

Source: I Shall Seal the Heavens Book 5 ch. 735 "War!" (the Blood Demon Sect's five summits form a five-layered restrictive spell shield, each layer kept by Spirit Severing experts); A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 346; A Will Eternal ch. 877.
kultivator.formasi.spec.small_spirit_gat: Members meditating inside gather qi ×(1 + 0.10 × P); your disciples meditating inside earn their own meditation XP × the same factor; the vein drains ×0.9. Radius 10, +1 per hall level above 1 (at most 14), +4 with a Murid Dalam+ keeper; height ±4. Standby while nobody cultivates inside. May also be built outside a territory as a personal formation.

9×9: an amethyst block on each corner with a tip on top (amethyst cluster, large bud, end rod, lantern or candle), a quartz pillar in the middle of each side, an amethyst cluster on the eye and an amethyst block under it.
Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality: Immortal Realm ch. 216 (a small spirit gathering array, about 30 feet across, fills a stone chamber with spiritual qi).
kultivator.formasi.spec.uniting_circle.d: Eight cushions. n = cushions with a meditating member or a meditating disciple on them, +1 for a keeper by the eye as the nucleus (at most 9). Everyone seated gets ×(1 + 0.03 × n × P) on top of the sect gathering factor, inside the cap. Stacks with the sect mate meditation bonus. Standby while every cushion is empty.
kultivator.formasi.spec.uniting_circle.h: 11×11: wool carpets 3 blocks north, south, east and west of the eye and 2 blocks diagonally; on each corner 2 amethyst blocks topped by an end rod, lantern, soul lantern or candle; an amethyst cluster or candle on the eye; a chiseled quartz block under it.
kultivator.formasi.spec.uniting_circle.s: Inspired by I Shall Seal the Heavens Book 5 ch. 735 (the Blood Demon Sect's Demonic Incarnation formation merges the cultivation bases of its disciples, with Meng Hao as its nucleus).
kultivator.formasi.spec.great_spirit_gat: Covers the whole sect territory: members meditating anywhere in it gather qi ×(1 + 0.20 × P), or ×(1 + 0.25 × P) when the eye stands at Y 120 or higher; your disciples' own meditation XP gets the same factor; vein drain ×0.8 (×0.7 with a Murid Dalam+ keeper). It never raises a vein itself. The Small array and this one never stack (the stronger counts).

15×15: eight spirit spires (3 amethyst blocks and an end rod) at 7 blocks north, south, east and west and 5 blocks diagonally; four jade marks (prismarine, prismarine bricks or emerald block) 3 blocks diagonally; an amethyst cluster on the eye and a gold block under it. Build it high: Y 120+ is stronger.

Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 391 "A New Home" (the higher the building on the spirit vein, the greater the qi), ch. 131 (spirit stones power formations) and Immortal Realm ch. 216.
kultivator.formasi.spec.spirit_nurturing: Every 5 s, members, their pets and spirit beasts inside get Regeneration I (II from Hall Level 7 or with a Life/Wood keeper; players at most II); disciples heal faster. Members' qi regenerates ×(1 + 0.3 × P) and Qi Deviation passes ×1.33 faster. Never touches hostiles; pauses during the target's own tribulation. Radius 12, +1 per hall level above 3 (at most 18). Standby while nobody inside is hurt or deviating.

9×9: four sealed water sources 2 blocks from the eye; on each corner a moss block, azalea leaves and a light block (froglight, sea lantern, glowstone or shroomlight) stacked; a light block under the eye (the white egg). May also be built as a personal formation.
Inspired by A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality: Immortal Realm ch. 216 (a spirit gathering array fills a chamber with qi around a huge white egg). The healing numbers are game design.
kultivator.formasi.spec.earthfire.name: Earthfire Array
kultivator.formasi.spec.earthfire.desc: Alchemy furnaces in range (a cauldron on a lit campfire) refine with +0.05 × P success and in 8 s instead of 10 s; members inscribing talismans in range get +0.03 × P success. Radius 6 (+1 at Hall Level 5 and 9, +2 with a Murid Dalam+ keeper), height ±3. The Earth Lung Fire Array is its upgrade on the same eye.
kultivator.formasi.spec.earthfire.hint: 7×7: four polished blackstone bricks around the eye, chiseled polished blackstone with a soul lantern on top in each corner, and a magma block under the eye. Keep lava away from it.
kultivator.formasi.spec.earthfire.source: Source: A Will Eternal ch. 2 "The Ovens" (a wok engraved with an earthflame spell formation); A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 156 "Earth Lung Fire" and ch. 928 (refining directly with earthfire).
Furnaces in range refine with +0.10 × P success, one quality step better and in ×0.7 of the time; members inscribing in range get +0.05 × P success. Radius 8, height ±4. Replaces the Earthfire Array (they never stack).

The Earthfire pattern grown to 11×11: add magma blocks 2 blocks diagonally from the eye and four chimneys 5 blocks out (2 polished blackstone bricks with a lit soul campfire on top). Soul campfires and magma hurt whoever stands on them.
Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 156 (the Earth Lung Fire and its furnace), ch. 866 "The Yin Yang Pagoda" (a top-grade reservoir of Earth Lung Fire) and ch. 928.
kultivator.formasi.spec.golden_lightning: During their own heavenly tribulation, sect members inside take ×0.90 of each strike (×0.85 with a keeper or Lightning affinity); disciples' calamity strikes inside too. All formations together never go below ×0.70. Radius 12, +1 per hall level above 5 (at most 16). Standby except during a member's omen or strikes inside.

13×13: four masts of 4 cut copper (any oxidation, waxed or not) with an end rod on top in the corners, gold blocks 6 blocks north, south, east and west, and gilded blackstone (from bastions) or a gold block under the eye. No lightning rods.

Inspired by A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 1468 "Capturing Lightning" (a golden net devours the azure tribulation lightning) and ch. 1315 (few means can block a heavenly tribulation).
kultivator.formasi.spec.restriction_flag: Amplifies the nearest registered formation of yours within 8 blocks (not an Immortal-grade array or another flag): P +0.25, radius +2, killing arrays +1 target, its upkeep ×1.10. Fills the cracks: if the target misses exactly one block it keeps working at half power for 10 minutes (20 with a keeper at the flag) before it breaks. The block itself is never restored.
7×7: eight polished blackstone bricks 3 blocks north, south, east and west and 2 blocks diagonally, a banner on the eye (black looks best) and chiseled polished blackstone under it.
Source: Renegade Immortal ch. 291 (restrictions placed onto a restriction flag), ch. 527 "Life Force Seals" (restriction gas flows along a formation's cracks and its power rises) and ch. 233 "Stop".
kultivator.formasi.spec.qi_small.name: Small Qi Gathering Formation
kultivator.formasi.spec.qi_small.desc: Your personal meditation seat: 4 amethyst blocks level with the block you sit on, 3 blocks away in each direction. Meditation ×1.25. It needs no Formation Eye and no Daya.
kultivator.formasi.spec.qi_small.hint: Shown here for reference only; it works without an eye.
kultivator.formasi.spec.qi_small.source: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 391 and Immortal Realm ch. 216 (spirit gathering arrays).
kultivator.formasi.spec.qi_great.name: Great Qi Gathering Formation
kultivator.formasi.spec.qi_great.desc: A personal seat on a gold block with 8 amethyst blocks at distance 3 (sides and corners). Meditation ×1.6. No eye and no Daya.
kultivator.formasi.spec.qi_great.hint: Shown here for reference only; it works without an eye.
kultivator.formasi.spec.qi_great.source: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 391 and Immortal Realm ch. 216 (spirit gathering arrays).
kultivator.formasi.spec.qi_heavenly.name: Heavenly Star Formation
kultivator.formasi.spec.qi_heavenly.desc: The Great seat with end rods on the four side pillars and a beacon or lodestone under the gold block. Meditation ×2.2. No eye and no Daya.
kultivator.formasi.spec.qi_heavenly.hint: Shown here for reference only; it works without an eye.
kultivator.formasi.spec.qi_heavenly.sour: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 391 and Immortal Realm ch. 216 (spirit gathering arrays).
kultivator.formasi.spec.protective.name: Protective Formation
kultivator.formasi.spec.protective.desc: A lodestone with 4 crying obsidian pillars 4 blocks away, charged with amethyst: monsters within 16 blocks are pushed out and tribulation strikes inside land ×0.85. It keeps its own power and needs no Formation Eye.
kultivator.formasi.spec.protective.hint: Shown here for reference only; it is woken on its lodestone.
kultivator.formasi.spec.protective.sourc: Source: the protective formations of A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality (sects shelter behind great protective formations).
kultivator.formasi.spec.formasi_agung.de: The sect's own great formation on the hall lodestone: radius 16 + 2 per hall level (at most 32), up to 4 layers and a guard disciple. It uses no active slot.
kultivator.formasi.spec.formasi_agung.hi: Shown here for reference only; it is built from the sect hall.
kultivator.formasi.spec.formasi_agung.so: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 346 (a sect's great protective formation).

kultivator.screen.help.formasi.title: Sect formations
kultivator.screen.help.formasi: Craft a Formation Eye (amethyst shards, a Low Spirit Stone, gold ingots and a lodestone), place it inside your sect territory and build a pattern around it; /kultivasi formasi pola <id> shows a read-only hologram layer by layer and the Formation tablet of the hall scroll lists all 24 patterns. Sneak-use the eye with an amethyst shard or a spirit stone to register it (Blood Recognition); missing blocks are marked. Grades Yellow, Mystic, Earth, Heaven and Immortal open at Hall Level 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9, and the hall level sets how many may run at once (2 to 6). Each core holds 48 hours of Daya: amethyst (Yellow and Mystic only) and spirit stones fill it, the rest goes to the Formation Kas, which tops cores up by itself; Daya never comes back out as items. Disciples can keep a formation: Keep lowers the upkeep, Empower raises the power, Watch guards the radius. States: Dormant, Broken, Suspended (the reason is shown), Active without Daya, Powered and Kept. Formations only read blocks, never change them, never hurt players, pets or disciples, and a formation kill gives no cultivation XP, cores or stones: they protect, they do not farm. Hiding members' nametags from strangers is cosmetic only. Commands: /kultivasi formasi [info | katalog | pola | tuju | nyala | mati | setor | isi | penjaga]. Sources: The Mirror Legacy ch. 34 (the formation eye and blood recognition); I Shall Seal the Heavens Book 5 ch. 735; A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 131, 391, 557 and Immortal Realm ch. 216; Battle Through the Heavens ch. 2 (the grade names).
